notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-resp-options (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): RESP on FORMATTIME (INVREQ RESP2 1 for ABSTIME below zero), ASKTIME NOHANDLE with no ABSTIME, READQ TS LENGTH(LENGTH OF area) (LENGERR truncation), RECEIVE MAP ... ASIS keeps lower case. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: formattime
scenarios.why: ASKTIME NOHANDLE (no ABSTIME) and ASKTIME ABSTIME; FORMATTIME with RESP / RESP2 on the clock's ABSTIME (NORMAL) and on an ABSTIME of -1 (INVREQ RESP2 1)

scenarios.name: readq-length
scenarios.why: READQ TS INTO(12 bytes) LENGTH(LENGTH OF it) of a 20-byte item (LENGERR, truncated) and of a 12-byte item (NORMAL)

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: takes the EVALUATE/IF arm no crucible scenario reaches: a mode no WHEN names (falls through)

scenarios.name: show-map
scenarios.why: mode A: SEND MAP HCM1 (the crucible's asis scenario step 0) then RETURN TRANSID('HC52'); the second leg (RECEIVE MAP ASIS under HC52) is a separate task the harness cannot start under its own transid
